name: secret-guard
description: Keeps API keys, cloud credentials and other secrets out of what is sent to the model: every text that enters the conversation is scanned and each match is replaced with a meaningful placeholder such as <google api key>.

language.title: Language
language.description: UI language: auto (from LC_ALL / LC_MESSAGES / LANG), en, zh-TW or ja. Placeholders stay English in every language.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Off: nothing is scanned or rewritten

keep_hint.title: Keep a hint
keep_hint.description: Keep the last 4 characters of each secret in the placeholder, e.g. <google api key …Zx3f>, to tell keys apart

entropy_backstop.title: High-entropy backstop
entropy_backstop.description: Also redact long random-looking tokens that sit next to a secret-ish name (key, token, password, …)

custom_patterns.title: Custom patterns
custom_patterns.description: Extra detectors, one per line as label=regex (JavaScript syntax, applied globally). Invalid lines are reported once and ignored.

allow_patterns.title: Allow patterns
allow_patterns.description: One regex per line; a match that also matches one of these is left alone (test fixtures, documented examples)

scan_tool_results.title: Scan tool results
scan_tool_results.description: Off: only your own prompts, slash-command rows and the context blocks are scanned; file contents, command output and other tool results pass through

band_style.title: Band style
band_style.description: How this mod's line above the prompt is framed: box (a rounded frame), rule (a thin line beneath), plain (text only)

fingerprints.title: Fingerprints
fingerprints.description: Record a short fingerprint of each redacted value (HMAC-SHA256 under a random key made for this session), so /secret-guard log can tell the same secret from a different one. Never the value; nothing is kept past the session.
